body:
Scope: README.md only (repo root, product surface).

Context: the supervisor supplied an outside review of the README's
first-impression problem (architecture-first opening, encyclopedia
Contents table on screen one) and asked for a front-door rewrite using
that review as input, not gospel. The rewrite leads with the
agent-amnesia problem and the read/update session rule, keeps the
"Working on this repo" section verbatim in title (kickoff.md and
workflows/active.md point at it by name), and preserves every
maintainer-discipline fact (manifest regen, suite, self-hosting,
one-workstream rule).

Safety: no overlap with the 1.1.2 release in flight in the main tree
(core/VERSION, core/CHANGELOG.md, core/MANIFEST.sha256). Integration
plan: fast-forward push onto origin/main after the release lands;
rebase if it moved.
